annotations.title: Asset Risk Score and Escalation Verdict

description: Synthesises vendor, model, firmware, sector, and network context into a branchable risk verdict. Returns risk_score (0-100), escalate (boolean), recommended_action, and contributing threat actors. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].
